title: Per-slice manifest exported from an approved execution-envelope-v0 slice
$comment: BEI-134. Supported keyword subset (see scripts/schema_check.py): type, required, properties, enum, items, minimum, pattern only. Naming note: this file validates slices/<slice-id>.json - the runner-consumable projection the `envelope` skill writes per approved execution-envelope-v0 slice (docs/configuration.md 'Execution Envelope v0' and 'Export bundles'). Its own `schema` field literal is `approved-slice-v1` or `rondo-execution-request-v1`, not `execution-envelope-v0`; the filename follows the BEI-134 ticket naming for the pre-export envelope concept it projects from. docs/configuration.md's per-slice field-list sentence (~L646) also names boundaries, dependencies, proof_requirements, output_expectations, parent_contract, allowed_actions, and process_provider; those are declared below as unconstrained (`{}`) for doc/schema field-list parity because scripts/validate_export.py has never inspected their shape (observed to vary across committed bundles - e.g. `boundaries` is a list of strings in one fixture and an {include, exclude} object in a committed bundle - so declaring a type here would be new, unrequested enforcement). The following stay in scripts/validate_export.py as code: (1) `slice_id` must equal the slice id derived from the filename - needs the filename, which is outside the JSON payload; (2) `prompt` OR `body` must be present and non-empty - an OR requirement, not expressible without oneOf; (3) `runner_extensions.model_routing.candidates` and `.routing` must be non-empty when present - minItems isn't in the subset.

prompt.$comment: Optional here; scripts/validate_export.py requires prompt OR body to be a non-empty string (code-level OR, not schema-expressible).

body.$comment: Legacy alias for prompt; see prompt's $comment. Not named in docs/configuration.md's per-slice field list - see BEI-134 report.

proof_requirements.$comment: proof-requirement-v1 items per docs/configuration.md 'Proof Requirement v1'; shape not enforced here (validator never inspects it on a slice manifest).

items.$comment: RON-146 v0: executable exit-code command-proof, distinct from `proof_requirements` (proof-requirement-v1 attestation, see docs/configuration.md 'Proof Requirement v1'). Rondo's clean-eval executor runs `command` post-gates and grades by exit-code equality only (default `expected_exit: 0`). Optional array; absent/empty is valid on every slice (back-compat) - the `envelope` skill warns, but the validator never requires it, for a code-changing slice with none.

candidates.$comment: Must also be non-empty; enforced in code (minItems not in the supported subset).

routing.$comment: Optional; when present must also be non-empty - enforced in code.
